title: Owner of a run lease or a checkout lock
description: Who holds a lock: <run>/lease.json (the run lease) or <runs root>/checkouts/<sha16>.json (the checkout lock, which also names the run). Written right after the lock is taken, removed when it is released; read only to name the owner of a busy lock.

started_at.description: UTC time the lock was taken.

command.description: Conductor command that holds it (run, resume, ...).

run.description: Run that drives the checkout (checkout lock only).
